content.short: A global crypto-fiat payment gateway bridging traditional finance and the crypto economy in over 170 countries.
content.description:
Alchemy Pay is a global payment gateway that bridges traditional fiat finance with the cryptocurrency economy. Operating in over 170 countries, it provides seamless fiat on and off-ramps, allowing users to buy crypto using local payment methods like cards and bank transfers. Its hybrid payment system enables merchants to accept both fiat and cryptocurrency while settling in local currency.

The platform also offers crypto-linked cards for instant global spending. With the upcoming Alchemy Chain, a dedicated Layer-1 for stablecoin payments, Alchemy Pay continues to drive mainstream adoption of digital assets through secure and practical payment utility.
